Fixed rules
    

  • Block N costs the requirement x 2^(N-1) shares, so holding N blocks needs requirement x (2^N - 1) shares in total. Each extra block pays the same benefit.
    • 

  • Each stock has one payout timer. Blocks bought while it runs wait and are not in the next payout; after that payout, all held blocks pay together every full interval.
    • 

  • Selling into a higher block drops it from the next payout and the timer keeps running. Dropping below block 1 resets the timer.
    • 

  • Selling stock costs 0.1%. The item-market fee is 5% (fixed).
    • 

  • MCS is capped at 10 blocks. Incomplete blocks are spare cash, not income.
    • 

  • Share price changes are not counted as profit.
    • 

  • The bank reinvests $3B each time. Profit is whatever comes back above that.
    • 

  • Item values are API averages or lowest listings (your choice above), not what you would net selling many units.
